proposals.evidence: CDIAL 13290 *savāra explicitly gives Gujarati savār morning/dawn and savārũ early. Western Bhil havāre fits this family with initial s weakening to h and the final adverbial vowel retained. It is distinguished from *savēla; local Indo-Aryan transmission remains open. Exact response: havāre.
